sents.zh: 有了纸以后，人们可以写书了。
sents.en: Once there was paper, people could write books.

sents.zh: 可是那时候的书都是一个字一个字写出来的。
sents.en: But books then were written out one character at a time.

sents.zh: 写一本书要很多天，有时候要几个月。
sents.en: Writing one book took many days, sometimes months.
So books were few, and expensive.

sents.zh: 只有很有钱的人才买得起。
sents.en: Only the wealthy could afford them.

sents.zh: 后来，有人想到了一个好办法。
sents.en: Later someone thought of a good way.

sents.zh: 他们把字刻在木头上面。
sents.en: They carved the characters into a block of wood.

sents.zh: 刻好以后，在上面放上黑色的墨。
sents.en: Once carved, they put black ink on it.

sents.zh: 然后把纸放上去，用手一按。
sents.en: Then they laid paper on it and pressed with the hand.

sents.zh: 拿起来的时候，字就到了纸上。
sents.en: When it was lifted, the characters were on the paper.

sents.zh: 因为一块木可以用很多次，所以做得非常快。
sents.en: Because one block could be used many times, it went very fast.

sents.zh: 一天可以做出以前一个月的书。
sents.en: A day could produce what once took a month.

sents.zh: 书便宜了以后，读书的人也多了。
sents.en: Once books were cheap, more people read.

sents.zh: 不只是有钱人，其他人也可以看书了。
sents.en: Not only the rich, but others too could read.

sents.zh: 这个办法后来到了别的国家，改变了世界。
sents.en: This method later reached other countries and changed the world.
